newsitem.title: USA: CIT Group files $7.5 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: CIT Group files $7.5 bln shelf.

text.p: CIT Group Holdings Inc, a consumer finance concern, filed a shelf offering Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $7.5 billion in debt securities.

The company, which is 80-percent owned by Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and 20-percent owned by Chase Manhattan Corp, said the offering brings total registrations to $9.811 billion when added to previously-registered debt.
Proceeds from the sale will be used initially to reduce short-term borrowings, the company said in the shelf offering.
